name: Nancy Drew: The Phantom of Venice

locations.note: Recruited by the Italian police, Nancy lodges in the Ca' Nascosta across from suspect Antonio Fango's office to unmask the Phantom, a caped thief whose gang uses commedia dell'arte code names.
Nancy draws cash and buys papers at the square's cash machine and news kiosk.
Nancy shops for disguises at Vera's costume shop on the square.
